output.situation_title: Rising property claims and new response-time rules put pressure on how claims are run
situation: In 2025, property damage claims rose and the supervisor issued guidance on claims-handling response times.
One peer insurer centralized property claims triage in a single hub in 2025 and reported shorter triage times.
For Atlântico Seguros, the property and health claims model likely needs to change, not just speed up.
output.belief: We believe the largest gains will come from how claims are triaged and routed, not from new IT.
